english_translations.sahih_international: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
english_translations.pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
english_translations.shakir: Except the seeking of the pleasure of his Lord, the Most High.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: except the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Except only the desire to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High;
english_translations.arberry: only seeking the Face of his Lord the Most High;

ayahs.translation_bn: সে অবশ্যই অতি শীঘ্র (আল্লাহর নি‘মাত পেয়ে) সন্তুষ্ট হয়ে যাবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And he is going to be satisfied.
ayahs.conventional_en: And he is going to be satisfied.
ayahs.conventional_bn: সে অবশ্যই অতি শীঘ্র (আল্লাহর নি‘মাত পেয়ে) সন্তুষ্ট হয়ে যাবে।
ayahs.meta_bn: অনিবার্য ঐশী নিশ্চয়তা: অচিরেই সে পরম সন্তুষ্টি ও পরিতৃপ্তি লাভ করবে

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ر-ض-و (r-ḍ-w): complete serenity, fulfillment in the eternal sanctuary.

english_translations.sahih_international: And he is going to be satisfied.
english_translations.pickthall: He verily will be content.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
english_translations.shakir: And he shall soon be well-pleased.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and the reward (of their Lord) will certainly make them happy.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: He surely will be pleased (when he will enter Paradise).
english_translations.arberry: and he shall surely be satisfied.
